title: BYOC self-hosted cloud computer on a real VPS: deploy, prepare, sessions

client.location: unknown for this run (not reported; not inferred from latency)
client.network: home LAN over Wi-Fi/Ethernet, route to the server through a WireGuard tunnel (utun); carrier unknown
client.client_daemon: fen built from source 611e82a, run in an isolated HOME (no Runta account; USER changed so no Keychain credential is read)

server.machine: n2-standard-8, Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS, x86_64, Docker 29.1.3 (shared development VM runta-devbox-singapore)
server.reached_at: private WireGuard address, TCP port 2223 published by Docker; address withheld

provenance.network_baseline: ICMP to the server over the tunnel, 10 samples: min 5.604, avg 16.738, max 75.275, stddev 20.849 ms
provenance.attribution: server region and machine from live GCP metadata; client facts from live system inventory; client geography and carrier unknown
provenance.other_load: the VM also ran unrelated development services (supabase, registries, minio, a Vite dev server); not controlled

boundaries.deploy_and_pair: wall time of `fen cloud byoc deploy runta-gcp-singapore --port 2223` from the Mac: SSH to the server, docker pull (image not cached), container start, host key read back over the same SSH connection, pairing over the WireGuard path
boundaries.preparation: daemon launch profile prepare.total, from pairing to services ready (terminal service push, Herdr, five agents installed by npm on the server)
boundaries.launch_receipt: `fen launch codex` process wall time until the receipt
boundaries.input_ready_tui: from launch start until `fen read` shows the Codex TUI on the cloud screen
boundaries.model_reply: from `fen send` until the reply is visible on the cloud screen; dominated by the model provider
boundaries.warm_operations: `fen control <method>` process wall time on the Mac including CLI process start, resident channel warm; 10 sequential samples each
boundaries.attach: `fen attach` over a pseudo-terminal until the live screen shows the reply
boundaries.unreachable: time from `docker stop` on the server until state.get reports stage unreachable (threshold 15 s), and from `docker start` until stage ready with the broker ready

cleanup: container, volume (with the synchronized credential copy) and image removed from the server; isolated HOME with the copied codex credential removed from the Mac; the original ~/.codex/auth.json digest was unchanged
single_run: one run, not a controlled comparison; numbers are observations for this path only
